title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ComputeFunctionConfiguration
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ComputeFunctionConfiguration. InstantiationRequirements for compute functions. Subclass of InstantiationRequirement per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the InstantiationRequirement model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ComputeFunctionConfiguration'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

computeFunctionQuotas.description: Relationship. Quotas available for compute functions. Links to one or more ComputeFunctionQuotas entities.

computeFunctionLibrary.description: Relationship. Library of compute function templates available. Links to one or more ComputeFunctionTemplate entities.

computeFunctionRuntime.description: Relationship. Available runtime(s) for executing the function. Links to one or more ComputeFunctionRuntime entities.

computeFunctionSDK.description: Relationship. SDKs provided to ease function development. Links to one or more ComputeFunctionRuntime entities.

computeFunctionTrigger.description: Relationship. Available trigger(s) for starting function execution. Links to one or more ComputeFunctionTrigger entities.

computeFunctionDeploymentMethod.description: Property. Supported methods for importing/deploying compute function code. Controlled-vocabulary value (ComputeFunctionDeploymentMethod), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

confidentialComputingTechnology.description: Relationship. Details with respect to confidential computing requirements. Links to a ConfidentialComputing entity.
